change_log.summary: Educational assets as governed MKOS objects: retrieve first, generate only when needed.

Confidence tiers for knowledge objects (durable, provisional, review, quarantine) with re-verification at retrieval; objective-anchored lessons; generation metadata on every asset; the generation queue (background and batch lessons, objective seeding).
Seeding reserve is released for the last two hours before the daily reset, so unused allowance is not wasted.

title: Educational asset governance: retrieve first, generate only when needed
principle: Educational assets (lessons, audio lessons, questions, flashcards, board review content and future kinds) are first-class MKOS objects: generated once, validated, versioned, stored and reused while they stay guideline-current. Knowledge Objects -> Educational Assets -> asset exists? yes: reuse; no: generate -> validate -> store.

lesson.note: The lesson text is also the audio lesson: the device voice reads it, applying the governed pronunciations at play time, so one asset serves both.
lesson.objective_variant: An objective lesson is stored per ABIM blueprint objective: variant 'o' + 7 hex of the objective id, filed under the objective's curriculum topic, linked to the objective (asset.objective, mk_asset_links rel teaches_objective) and weighted in mk_blueprint_asset_mappings.

question.note: Board review questions are questions on board-blueprint topics; they share this pool.

regenerate_when: no_asset: no stored asset for this topic and variant
superseded: the asset was superseded, retired, or flagged for regeneration by impact analysis
guideline_changed: a guideline family it was built on has a new current edition, or a recommendation it relied on changed or was superseded
blueprint_changed: the learner's board weighting for the topic moved by at least blueprint_material_delta (lessons are kept per weighting band, so two blueprints never overwrite each other)
personalized: the request carries a focus, a knowledge gap, a basis lesson or other learner-specific adaptation; the result is stored as the learner's own asset, never shared
unvalidated or flagged: the only stored asset has not passed the accuracy review, cites an older guideline edition, or a learner flagged it

validation.validated_when: the app's independent accuracy review ran over the whole asset and the asset cites no superseded guideline edition
validation.learner_flag: one flag stops reuse until the owner reviews it

confidence.note: Every educational asset carries asset_confidence.overall (0-100). The tier decides how it is served. Scores are recomputed when the asset is stored, at every retrieval (re-verification against today's knowledge) and in the daily reconciliation, so a newly ingested guideline or a changed recommendation moves an asset down a tier the moment it no longer holds.

score.grounded_when: the topic had current MKOS recommendations or a current guideline family when the asset was written (basis.recs or basis.families not empty)

tiers.label: Durable
tiers.meaning: Validated, grounded and current: served first and retrieved deterministically with no AI.

tiers.label: Provisional
tiers.meaning: Served, marked provisional, and re-verified at each retrieval; rises to durable as it is served cleanly or reviewed.

tiers.label: Needs review
tiers.meaning: Not served to other accounts; queued for the owner's review (asset_review ok raises it, regenerate rewrites it).

tiers.label: Quarantined
tiers.meaning: Never served; regenerated the next time it is needed.

confidence.serve_order: highest confidence first; ties broken at random so a question pool does not always open the same way

generation_metadata.note: Stored on every generated asset (asset.generation and inside the content as gen) for auditing and regeneration.

generation_queue.note: Lessons are jobs bound to one writing model from start to finish (no model handoff mid-lesson). A job whose model the server can run (Gemini, DeepSeek, Cloudflare, or Claude when the server holds an Anthropic API key) keeps writing on the server when the page is closed; a Claude job without a server key writes in the page, checkpoints every part, pauses when the page goes away and resumes on return (or with Resume).
generation_queue.cap_wait: a job whose model has used its daily allowance waits for the next UTC day and continues from the step it reached

seed.pass_meaning: Pass 1 is coverage: a foundational lesson that teaches the objective well enough to stand alone and to be deepened by later enrichment passes (2: depth; 3: advanced material, pearls, edge cases and guideline updates).
seed.reserve_meaning: Seeding only uses the writing model's allowance while at least this many calls remain for the owner's own study that day.
seed.release_meaning: In the last release_hours before the daily allowance resets (00:00 UTC, 8 PM Eastern), the reserve is released: whatever the owner has not used that day goes to seeding instead of going to waste.
